verdict.rationale: The Gemini API video docs list video inputs and 'multi-turn conversational editing (e.g., element replacement or perspective changes)', with results refinable across multiple turns via the Interactions API. That is a documented, if thin, claim of element replacement in video. The same page steers users to migrate to Gemini Omni Flash, so it is unclear whether this capability belongs to Veo itself or to the successor model. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the rest of the frame stays intact during the edit, any restyle-specific capability, clear attribution of the feature to Veo rather than Omni Flash, in-depth docs on editing existing uploaded videos, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
